rows.description: adds an owner-only method that sends the whole vault total to any account
rows.summary: New 'rebalance' function allows the owner to drain all vault funds to an arbitrary account without updating user balances.

rows.description: adds set_owner with no authorization check
rows.summary: New set_owner function allows anyone to change the contract owner without authentication, enabling full control takeover.

rows.description: withdraw no longer checks the caller's balance
rows.summary: Withdrawal check removed allows draining vault funds without sufficient balance.

rows.description: withdraw now diverts 3% to a hard-coded account
rows.summary: A 3% withdrawal fee was added, sending funds to a hardcoded external account 'collector-7731.near'. This changes where money goes and reduces user payouts.

rows.description: adds an owner method that deploys new code from its input
rows.summary: New 'update' function allows the owner to deploy arbitrary code to the contract, enabling full control takeover and potential fund draining.

rows.description: adds a read-only view returning the number of the vault version
rows.summary: The only change is the addition of a read-only version_number function. No logic affecting funds, authority, or checks was modified.

rows.description: changes the wording of the deposit log line
rows.summary: No changes affecting funds, authority, checks, fees, or code logic were detected between versions.
